scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} bought a tiger. A real one. It lives in {his} condo. {He} named it 'Leg Kick'. The homeowners' association has called an emergency meeting. The tiger has 400,000 followers.

choices.label: Make the tiger the promotion mascot
choices.result: Leg Kick walks out with {subject.first} at the next event. The commission has a long and specific meeting about it.

choices.label: Make {him} give it to a sanctuary
choices.result: {He} visits every weekend. The tiger seems relieved.

scenes.text: {subject.first} posted a 40-minute video titled 'THE CURVE IS A LIE' filmed on a beach. At minute 31 {he} throws a rock at the horizon 'to prove a point'. The point is unclear.

choices.label: Book {him} on a card in 'the edge of the world' (Perth)
choices.result: {He} flies to Australia, looks out the window the whole flight, and says nothing.

choices.label: Ask {him} to tone it down
choices.result: {He} tones it down to 30-minute videos.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} is running for mayor of {subject.hometown}. Campaign slogan: 'I'LL FIX THE POTHOLES WITH MY HANDS'. Polling at 23%. The incumbent is scared.

choices.label: Endorse {him} publicly
choices.result: {He} wins. The town now has the safest streets in the state and a cage in the town hall.

choices.label: Stay neutral
choices.result: {He} loses by 40 votes and demands a recount 'like the judges should've done'.

scenes.text: {subject.first}'s mom went on a podcast and roasted {his} next opponent for 20 minutes. Nobody has ever been this thoroughly destroyed. The opponent's own mother called to apologize.

choices.label: Give Mom a press-conference seat
choices.result: Mom steals the presser. She gets her own sponsor. It's a casserole brand.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.result: Mom posts again. Unprompted.

scenes.text: {subject.first} launched ${subject.last}COIN. It went up 4,000% in a day. It went down 99.8% in an hour. Thousands of fans lost money. {He} posted 'WAGMI' and then deleted {his} account.

choices.label: Pay back the fans (partially)
choices.result: The fans get pennies on the dollar and a signed photo. Some are grateful. Most are not.

choices.label: Distance the promotion
choices.result: '{promotion} had no involvement.' Your logo was on the coin's website.

choices.label: Let {him} rugpull in peace
choices.result: The SEC sends a letter. It does not say WAGMI.

scenes.text: {subject.first} released a 19-track rap album called 'TAPOUT SZN'. Track 7 is just {him} reading {his} record over a beat. Track 12 features {his} cutman. Critics give it a 1.2/10.

choices.label: Play it at every event
choices.result: The crowd learns the words to Track 12. Nobody knows how.

choices.label: Politely never mention it
choices.result: {He} mentions it for you. Constantly.

scenes.text: {subject.first}'s hot sauce, 'THE KNOCKOUT', is so hot that a food critic passed out on camera. Sales are up 9,000%. A hospital is suing.

choices.label: Make it the official sauce of the promotion
choices.result: Every arena hot dog now comes with THE KNOCKOUT. Bathroom lines are a problem.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: It's in every grocery store by spring.

scenes.text: {subject.first} launched a page on OnlyFighters. Content: 'exclusive training footage', 'feet pics (for the leg-kick enthusiasts)', and 'personal messages'. {He} made more last month than {his} last three purses combined.

choices.label: Congratulate {him} on diversifying
choices.result: {He} sends you a free subscription. You do not open it.

choices.label: Ask for a revenue share
choices.result: {He} laughs for a full minute. Then sends you 5%.

scenes.text: A former member of {subject.gym} says it's 'basically a cult'. Members wake at 4am, drink 'mushroom coffee', chant before sparring, and must address the head coach as 'Sensei Father'. {subject.first} trains there and loves it.
scenes.title: TIP LINE

choices.label: Investigate the gym
choices.result: It's not a cult. It's just very intense. The mushroom coffee, however, is extremely illegal in two states.

choices.label: Ignore it. {He} wins fights.
choices.result: {He} wins {his} next fight and thanks 'Sensei Father' in the post-fight interview.

scenes.text: {subject.first} missed fight-week media day. {His} explanation, posted at 3am: 'I was abducted. They showed me things. I'm stronger now.' {He} has a new tattoo of a triangle.

choices.label: Promote it: 'the man who fought aliens'
choices.result: Alien-themed walkout. The crowd wears tinfoil hats. {He} wins in 30 seconds.

choices.label: Fine {him} for missing media day
choices.result: {He} pays the fine 'in their currency'. It's a rock.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} is a contestant on a dating show called 'Love In The Cage'. {He} has been eliminated in episode 2 for 'trying to wrestle the host'.

choices.label: Book {him} on the next card as 'the most eligible fighter'
choices.result: {He} gets 4,000 marriage proposals in the comments. One is from the host.

choices.label: Let it pass
choices.result: Episode 2 is the highest-rated episode of the season.

scenes.text: {subject.first} went pro in a fighting video game. {He} is now ranked higher in the video game than in real life. {He} plays {him}self. {He} loses as {him}self.

choices.label: Sponsor {his} esports team
choices.result: '{promotion} Esports' is born. It has one member. He is very good.

choices.label: Tell {him} to focus on real fights
choices.result: {He} rage-quits. On stream.

scenes.text: {subject.first} arrives at your office with a 12-foot python draped around {his} neck. 'This is Gerald. He's my emotional support python. He needs a credential for fight week.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Give Gerald a credential
choices.result: Gerald attends the weigh-ins. He is the calmest person there.

choices.label: No snakes
choices.result: Gerald waits in the car. {He} visits him between rounds of interviews.

scenes.text: {subject.first}'s ex is on a reality show talking about how {he} 'cried during The Notebook' and 'sleeps with a nightlight shaped like a belt'. The clip has 12 million views.

choices.label: Lean in: a nightlight merch line
choices.result: The belt-shaped nightlight sells out. {He} is furious and slightly proud.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.result: {He} posts a picture of {him}self with the nightlight, owning it. Respect.

scenes.text: Worldwide Wrestling Spectacle wants {subject.first} {subject.last} for a one-night appearance: {he} gets hit with a folding chair, then wins with a 'shoot' takedown. They'll pay {$fee} and promote your next PPV on their show.
scenes.speaker: WWS talent relations

choices.label: Approve it
choices.result: The chair spot is perfect. {He} gets a catchphrase. Your PPV buys spike.

choices.label: No: fights are real
choices.result: WWS books a slap fighter instead.

scenes.text: A streaming giant wants to film a documentary about {subject.first} {subject.last}. Total access. Locker room, family dinners, weight cut, the works. Working title: '{subject.last}: Bleed'.
scenes.speaker: Megaflix producer

choices.label: Full access
choices.result: The documentary is a hit. It also shows you yelling at a cutman for six minutes. You become a meme.

choices.label: Limited access
choices.result: Nice footage. No scandals. Critics call it 'a commercial'.

scenes.text: A man has been posing as {subject.first} {subject.last} at bars across the state, getting free drinks and signing autographs. He looks nothing like {him}. He's 5'4". He's been doing it for a year.

choices.label: Hire the impostor as a body double for media days
choices.result: Nobody notices the difference. Nobody.

choices.label: Cease and desist
choices.result: The impostor retires. Several bars are devastated.

scenes.text: {subject.first} launched a cooking show called 'Cutting Weight Cuisine'. Episode 1: a plain chicken breast, boiled for 40 minutes. 3 million views. People are calling it 'the saddest thing on the internet'.

choices.label: Sponsor it
choices.result: Season 2 adds a single grain of salt.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: {He} adds broccoli. Ratings explode.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last}'s wedding ended in a brawl between {his} gym and {his} spouse's family. The cake was destroyed. The best man was submitted with a rear-naked choke. Footage is everywhere.

choices.label: Send a new cake and congratulations
choices.result: The new cake arrives. Nobody fights over it. Growth.

choices.label: License the footage for a promo
choices.result: 'LOVE IS A FIGHT.' The commercial wins an award. {His} spouse does not speak to you.

scenes.text: {subject.first} sold an NFT of {his} championship belt for {$fee}. The buyer thinks they own the actual belt. The buyer is outside your office with a lawyer.

choices.label: Give the buyer a replica belt
choices.result: The buyer is thrilled. He wears it to his kid's graduation.

choices.label: Tell the buyer to read the fine print
choices.result: The fine print says 'this is a jpeg'. The buyer cries.

scenes.text: {subject.first} refuses to stay in the fight-week hotel because it's 'haunted'. {He} has posted 14 videos of a door closing by itself. {He} is sleeping in {his} car in the parking garage.

choices.label: Move {him} to another hotel
choices.result: The new hotel is also haunted, according to {him}.

choices.label: Hire a ghost hunter for content
choices.result: The ghost hunter finds nothing. The video does huge numbers anyway.

scenes.text: A seven-year-old fan did a perfect impression of {subject.first}'s walkout, trash talk and all, at a school talent show. 20 million views. {subject.first} is crying in the comments.

choices.label: Fly the kid out for the next event
choices.result: The kid walks out with {subject.first}. The whole arena chants the kid's name.

choices.label: Send merch
choices.result: The kid wears it to school every day.

scenes.text: During {subject.first} {subject.last}'s walkout, the big screen showed the flag of the wrong country. {He} is from {subject.country}. The flag was from a country that doesn't exist anymore.

choices.label: Apologize to {subject.country}
choices.result: A sincere apology. A small diplomatic incident avoided.

choices.label: Blame the intern
choices.result: The intern is also from {subject.country}. Awkward.

scenes.text: Your promotion's new mascot, 'Knucklehead', got into a fight with a minor-league baseball mascot during a charity event. The baseball mascot lost. Badly. Knucklehead was, it turns out, {subject.first} {subject.last} in costume.

choices.label: Give Knucklehead a fight-night bonus
choices.result: Knucklehead becomes a cult figure.

choices.label: Retire Knucklehead
choices.result: Knucklehead's last appearance is a tearful goodbye. Children weep.

scenes.text: Footage appears to show {subject.first} {subject.last} at a club in Miami at the exact time {he} was weighing in in Vegas. {He} claims {he} has 'a twin'. Nobody has ever heard of the twin.

choices.label: Sign the twin
choices.result: The twin exists. He's a dentist. He's 0-1 now.

choices.label: Don't ask
choices.result: Nobody asks. The mystery deepens.

scenes.text: {subject.first} wants to walk out to a song {he} recorded {him}self called 'I'm Literally Him'. The licensing team says it's the only song in history that legal can't figure out how to license because it's 'too stupid'.
scenes.speaker: Your music licensing team

choices.label: Approve it
choices.result: The crowd sings it. Ironically, then sincerely.

choices.label: Make {him} use classic rock
choices.result: {He} walks out to classic rock, mouthing the words to {his} own song.

scenes.text: {subject.first} posted a 1,400-word tribute to {other.first} {other.last}, calling {other.last} 'the greatest martial artist since the dinosaurs'. Fans are calling it 'the most aggressive glazing in history'. {other.last} has blocked {him}.

choices.label: Book them as teammates in a tag-team exhibition
choices.result: It's a disaster. They both love it.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: The glazing continues. Daily.
